what.text: This page follows refugees from Greece living in Serbia and Kosovo, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 1973, the last year with a figure, UNHCR counted 5180 Greek refugees in Serbia and Kosovo, 100.0% of all refugees from Greece that year.
UNHCR's data has no figure for this group after 1973.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Greece, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 1965 and 1967 to 1970.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group runs from 1965, at 17690 refugees, to 1973.
The figure was at its highest, 18930, in 1969 and 1970.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Serbia and Kosovo.
These are year-end totals for Serbia and Kosovo only, reported to UNHCR from 1965 to 1973.
